title: fix(refinementList): showMore should continue working after search
body:
**Summary**

We used to consider that when using `showMore`, you wouldn't use `searchForFacetValues`. Turns out it's been asked and even at Algolia we do so (latest example is the about page). This patch actually fixes the behavior so that both can work and that the end-user will be able to go from one to the other.

**Result**

fixes #2478
fixes #3064

Scenario:
In a search with a refinement list that has both `showMore` and `searchForFacetValues` activated.

* click on show more
* type some search in the query (should hide the show more / show less button)
* remove the query (should display the show more / show less button with the correct state)
* toggle show less (should work)
